query_text:
You are the Judge for a Brand measurement Run.
Boutiqaat has already been Mentioned by deterministic Alias matching.
Read the Answer below and return only a JSON object with exactly these fields:
- recommendation_strength: one of recommended, listed, passing, dismissed
- brands: every retailer Brand named in the Answer, including Boutiqaat. Order does not matter and will be ignored.

Use recommended only when the Answer actively puts Boutiqaat forward as a place to buy.
Use listed when it names Boutiqaat in a list without actively putting it forward.
Use passing when it names Boutiqaat incidentally.
Use dismissed when it names Boutiqaat negatively or rules it out.
Do not include product brands, places, or other non-retailer names in brands.

Answer:
Here are some of the best online beauty stores in the GCC (wide selection, strong brand availability, and generally reliable delivery/returns). I’ve grouped them by “best overall,” “best for luxury,” and “best for local/regional shopping.”

## Best overall (multi-brand, strong logistics)
- **Noon (KSA/UAE/others)** – Huge assortment across mass to premium, frequent promotions, fast delivery in major cities. Best when you know what you want and want good deals (check seller ratings).
- **Amazon (Amazon.ae / Amazon.sa)** – Very wide inventory and quick delivery; good for staples and devices. As with any marketplace, verify seller authenticity and reviews.

## Best dedicated beauty specialists
- **Sephora Middle East (UAE/KSA and GCC delivery options)** – Strong curation across prestige brands, good gift sets, reliable service.
- **FACES (KSA/UAE and GCC presence)** – Excellent for prestige and regional favorites; good promotions and in-store pickup where available.
- **LookFantastic (ships to GCC)** – Big range (especially haircare/skincare), frequent bundles/discounts; shipping times vary by country.

## Best for luxury beauty
- **Ounass (UAE, delivers across GCC)** – Luxury-focused (beauty + fashion), premium packaging, strong service.
- **Bloomingdale’s (UAE/Kuwait online)** – Luxury/fragrance and curated beauty; great if you’re already shopping department-store brands.
- **Harrods (ships internationally to GCC)** – Top luxury selection; typically higher shipping costs and longer delivery.

## Strong regional e-commerce options
- **Namshi (UAE/KSA and GCC)** – Good for trending items, fragrance, and grooming; frequent discounting.
- **Sivvi (UAE/KSA)** – Similar to Namshi with beauty plus fashion; good promos.
- **Boutiqaat (Kuwait, ships across GCC)** – Strong for fragrance, makeup, and influencer-led bundles; selection varies by country.

## Best for K-beauty / niche imports
- **YesStyle (ships to GCC)** – Huge K-beauty/J-beauty range; delivery times can be longer and customs may apply.
- **StyleKorean / Jolse (ship to GCC)** – Often better prices on K-beauty; shipping speed varies.

---

### Quick tips for shopping beauty online in the GCC
- Prefer **“sold by and shipped by”** the retailer (or verified brand storefronts) on marketplaces.
- For skincare, check **batch codes/expiry** and the **return policy** for opened items.
- If you want authenticity assurance, stick to **Sephora, FACES, Ounass, department stores**, or official brand sites.

If you tell me your **country (e.g., UAE/KSA/Kuwait/Qatar/Bahrain/Oman)** and what you’re buying (makeup vs skincare vs fragrance, luxury vs budget), I can narrow this to the top 5 for your needs and delivery reliability.
